name: review
description: Multi-dimension code review: four reviewers in parallel, then two verifiers, then a synthesis.

nodes.label: map the change
nodes.prompt: Read the current diff (git diff HEAD) and list every file it touches, grouped by subsystem. For each group say in one line what the change is trying to do. Do not evaluate it yet.

nodes.label: correctness
nodes.prompt:
Review the change below for CORRECTNESS only: logic errors, unhandled cases, race conditions, off-by-ones, wrong assumptions about the code it calls. Cite file:line for every finding. Ignore style, naming and test coverage — other reviewers own those.

{{scope}}

nodes.label: security
nodes.prompt:
Review the change below for SECURITY only: injection, path traversal, secret handling, permission and sandbox boundaries, anything that widens what the agent may do without the user asking. Cite file:line. Ignore correctness and style.

{{scope}}

nodes.label: test coverage
nodes.prompt:
Review the change below for TEST COVERAGE only: which new behaviour has no test, which existing test would not have caught the bug this change fixes, which test asserts an implementation detail rather than a behaviour. Cite file:line.

{{scope}}

nodes.label: stale prose
nodes.prompt:
Find prose this change makes WRONG: comments, docstrings, README and docs/ text that describes the old behaviour. A stale doc is a defect. Cite file:line.

{{scope}}

nodes.label: check the reviewers
nodes.prompt: Four reviewers reported below. For EACH finding, open the cited file:line and decide whether it is real. Report three lists: CONFIRMED (with the evidence you read), REJECTED (with why the reviewer was wrong), and UNVERIFIABLE (the citation did not resolve). A reviewer's confidence is not evidence.

nodes.label: what nobody reviewed
nodes.prompt: Four dimension-scoped reviewers have reported. Read the DIFF ITSELF, not their reports, and find what falls BETWEEN their dimensions — the change that is individually correct, individually secure and individually tested, and still wrong as a whole. Interface mismatches, an invariant two files now disagree about, a migration with no rollback, a behaviour change nobody named. Cite file:line. Say plainly if you find nothing: a scoped reviewer set misses things, and pretending otherwise is the failure this node exists to catch.

nodes.label: synthesize
